TEXT.source: kanakanavu.info, "Mo'o 2014 Story 2", https://kanakanavu.info/language-documentation/moo-2014-story-2.html. This story was recorded by Ilka Wild in collaboration with Elizabeth Zeitoun in March 2014 in Namasia village. The speaker is Mo'o Kangena.

S.FORM: 'una kan kanakanavu miena maracoocua mata ucang-in.
S.PHON: ʔuna kan kanakanavu miena ma[r|ɾ]aʦooʦua mata uʦaŋin
S.FORM: 'una kan kanakanavu miena maracoocua mata ucangin.
S.PHON: ʔuna kan kanakanavu miena ma[r|ɾ]aʦooʦua mata uʦaŋin
S.TRANSL: Long time ago there was a Kanakanavu, walking two together with his spouse.
He was walking two together with his spouse.
The woman was told by her husband:

S.FORM: mupara pa mapʉn vʉ'ʉ misei kan.
S.PHON: mupa[r|ɾ]a pa mapɨn vɨʔɨ misei kan
S.FORM: mupara pa mapʉn vʉ'ʉ misei kan.
S.PHON: mupa[r|ɾ]a pa mapɨn vɨʔɨ misei kan
S.TRANSL: "Climb up and pluck the tangerine!" , he said.
The wife climbed up.

S.FORM: um-ara kan um-apʉn vʉ'ʉ mata'ʉnei makai kan saronei:
S.PHON: uma[r|ɾ]a kan umapɨn vɨʔɨ mataʔɨnei makai kan sa[r|ɾ]onei
S.FORM: umara kan umapʉn vʉ'ʉ mata'ʉnei makai kan saronei:
S.PHON: uma[r|ɾ]a kan umapɨn vɨʔɨ mataʔɨnei makai kan sa[r|ɾ]onei
S.TRANSL: She plucked and took the tangerine and came down and the man said:
"This is still not enough!"
"Take again!" he said.
"Take another one!" he said.

S.FORM: maka'ʉna kan ucang-in mupara um-ara mapʉn mata'ʉnei.
S.PHON: makaʔɨna kan uʦaŋin mupa[r|ɾ]a uma[r|ɾ]a mapɨn mataʔɨnei
S.FORM: maka'ʉna kan ucangin mupara umara mapʉn mata'ʉnei.
S.PHON: makaʔɨna kan uʦaŋin mupa[r|ɾ]a uma[r|ɾ]a mapɨn mataʔɨnei
S.TRANSL: His wife went up again to pluck and took it and came down.
The man saw the tangerines.

S.FORM: ah ka'an pa mustanpʉ misei kan.
S.PHON: ah kaʔan pa mustanpɨ misei kan
S.FORM: ah ka'an pa mustanpʉ misei kan.
S.PHON: ah kaʔan pa mustanpɨ misei kan
S.TRANSL: "It's still not enough!" he said.

S.FORM: mupara pa kan sua ucang-in mapʉn.
S.PHON: mupa[r|ɾ]a pa kan sua uʦaŋin mapɨn
S.FORM: mupara pa kan sua ucangin mapʉn.
S.PHON: mupa[r|ɾ]a pa kan sua uʦaŋin mapɨn
S.TRANSL: His wife climbed still to pluck.
And then the man said:

S.FORM: ah nanakʉ numanei cu tia iiku mapʉn misei kan.
S.PHON: ah nanakɨ numanei ʦu tia iiku mapɨn misei kan
S.FORM: ah nanakʉ numanei cu tia iiku mapʉn misei kan.
S.PHON: ah nanakɨ numanei ʦu tia iiku mapɨn misei kan
S.TRANSL: Ah, woman, don't do it, I will go myself and pluck!" he said.
The man climbed up.

S.FORM: mupara kan tia mapʉn matapari'i kan sua saronei.
S.PHON: mupa[r|ɾ]a kan tia mapɨn matapa[r|ɾ]iʔi kan sua sa[r|ɾ]onei
S.FORM: mupara kan tia mapʉn matapari'i kan sua saronei.
S.PHON: mupa[r|ɾ]a kan tia mapɨn matapa[r|ɾ]iʔi kan sua sa[r|ɾ]onei
S.TRANSL: He climed wanting to pluck, but he fell down.
He fell down to earth and died.
His wife said to her husband.

S.FORM: ah tia pokarin manu apa-cʉ'ʉra inia misei kan.
S.PHON: ah tia poka[r|ɾ]in manu apaʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]a inia misei kan
S.FORM: ah tia pokarin manu apacʉ'ʉra inia misei kan.
S.PHON: ah tia poka[r|ɾ]in manu apaʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]a inia misei kan
S.TRANSL: "I will tell the child to see its dad" she said.
She spoke to the kid.
Her child came to see him.

S.FORM: ah cuma miseen kasu ni-macei-in misei kan.
S.PHON: ah ʦuma miseen kasu nimaʦeiin misei kan
S.FORM: ah cuma miseen kasu nimaceiin misei kan.
S.PHON: ah ʦuma miseen kasu nimaʦeiin misei kan
S.TRANSL: "Ah father, why did you die?" it said.
His child accepted it.
The child took the father.
It took him.
It went on the street.

S.FORM: makaasi kan cacaan makaasi kan manu-in:
S.PHON: makaasi kan ʦaʦaan makaasi kan manuin
S.FORM: makaasi kan cacaan makaasi kan manuin:
S.PHON: makaasi kan ʦaʦaan makaasi kan manuin
S.TRANSL: It went on the street, his child said:
"Look at my father!" it said.
"my father!" it said.
To there.
She saw her child passing out.

S.FORM: t<in>akuviri kan cacaan sua manu-in ni-araka.
S.PHON: tinakuvi[r|ɾ]i kan ʦaʦaan sua manuin nia[r|ɾ]aka
S.FORM: tinakuviri kan cacaan sua manuin niaraka.
S.PHON: tinakuvi[r|ɾ]i kan ʦaʦaan sua manuin nia[r|ɾ]aka
S.TRANSL: The child passed out on the wayside.
It was like that.
It went on the street.

S.FORM: ah cina acu ni-macei cuma misei kan.
S.PHON: ah ʦina aʦu nimaʦei ʦuma misei kan
S.FORM: ah cina acu nimacei cuma misei kan.
S.PHON: ah ʦina aʦu nimaʦei ʦuma misei kan
S.TRANSL: "Ah, mother, father surely died." it said.

S.FORM: makasua cu mucaan kan sua manu cʉmʉra cuma-in.
S.PHON: makasua ʦu muʦaan kan sua manu ʦɨmɨ[r|ɾ]a ʦumain
S.FORM: makasua cu mucaan kan sua manu cʉmʉra cumain.
S.PHON: makasua ʦu muʦaan kan sua manu ʦɨmɨ[r|ɾ]a ʦumain
S.TRANSL: And then the child went to see his father.
His father stood up.
"Ah, child."

S.FORM: tee ku makanan acu ku ni-araka misei kan.
S.PHON: tee ku makanan aʦu ku nia[r|ɾ]aka misei kan
S.FORM: tee ku makanan acu ku niaraka misei kan.
S.PHON: tee ku makanan aʦu ku nia[r|ɾ]aka misei kan
S.TRANSL: "What should I do, I am dead." he said.
And then the child went away.
It found a snake.
It caught the snake.

S.FORM: ah manu akuni patisai vʉnei apitarʉ misei kan.
S.PHON: ah manu akuni patisai vɨnei apita[r|ɾ]ɨ misei kan
S.FORM: ah manu akuni patisai vʉnei apitarʉ misei kan.
S.PHON: ah manu akuni patisai vɨnei apita[r|ɾ]ɨ misei kan
S.TRANSL: "Ah, child, don't catch the snake, it is dangerous." he said.
The child didn't listen.
The child went to see the snake.

S.FORM: ni-patisa'ʉ kan kei tia piapaca'in kei ka'an kan.
S.PHON: nipatisaʔɨ kan kei tia piapaʦaʔin kei kaʔan kan
S.FORM: nipatisa'ʉ kan kei tia piapaca'in kei ka'an kan.
S.PHON: nipatisaʔɨ kan kei tia piapaʦaʔin kei kaʔan kan
S.TRANSL: It caught the snake wanting to kill the snake but it didn't.

S.FORM: ara-ei kan inia patakusʉʉrʉ sua vʉnei makai patakusʉʉrʉ na hʉ'ʉr-in.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aei kan inia patakusɨɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ sua vɨnei makai patakusɨɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ na hɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]in
S.FORM: araei kan inia patakusʉʉrʉ sua vʉnei makai patakusʉʉrʉ na hʉ'ʉrin.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aei kan inia patakusɨɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ sua vɨnei makai patakusɨɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ na hɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]in
S.TRANSL: It took it and the snake wind around his neck.

S.FORM: takasʉrʉ kan vʉnei na hʉ'ʉr-in makai takasʉrʉ.
S.PHON: takasɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ kan vɨnei na hɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]in makai takasɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.FORM: takasʉrʉ kan vʉnei na hʉ'ʉrin makai takasʉrʉ.
S.PHON: takasɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ kan vɨnei na hɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]in makai takasɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.TRANSL: The snake wound around it's neck.

S.FORM: mucaan kan avici inia makasi tanasa.
S.PHON: muʦaan kan aviʦi inia makasi tanasa
S.FORM: mucaan kan avici inia makasi tanasa.
S.PHON: muʦaan kan aviʦi inia makasi tanasa
S.TRANSL: It went away carrying it (the snake) and went home.

S.FORM: manasʉ tia apa-cʉ'ʉrʉ-ʉn kei cucumeen manu.
S.PHON: manasɨ tia apaʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]ɨɨn kei ʦuʦumeen manu
S.FORM: manasʉ tia apacʉ'ʉrʉʉn kei cucumeen manu.
S.PHON: manasɨ tia apaʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]ɨɨn kei ʦuʦumeen manu
S.TRANSL: Maybe it wanted to show it to the other kids.
"This is certainly a snake." it said.
It went home.
The child passed out.
It's mother was like that.
It's mother went there?

S.FORM: atian cu sua manu maku misa kan.
S.PHON: atian ʦu sua manu maku misa kan
S.FORM: atian cu sua manu maku misa kan.
S.PHON: atian ʦu sua manu maku misa kan
S.TRANSL: "Where is my child?" she said.

S.FORM: mua makaasi cʉmʉra manu-in ni-macei kan.
S.PHON: mua makaasi ʦɨmɨ[r|ɾ]a manuin nimaʦei kan
S.FORM: mua makaasi cʉmʉra manuin nimacei kan.
S.PHON: mua makaasi ʦɨmɨ[r|ɾ]a manuin nimaʦei kan
S.TRANSL: She went seeing her child, her child was dead.

S.FORM: ka'an kan tavara'ʉ murungisa sua manu-in.
S.PHON: kaʔan kan tava[r|ɾ]aʔɨ mu[r|ɾ]uŋisa sua manuin
S.FORM: ka'an kan tavara'ʉ murungisa sua manuin.
S.PHON: kaʔan kan tava[r|ɾ]aʔɨ mu[r|ɾ]uŋisa sua manuin
S.TRANSL: Her child did not breathe.

S.FORM: sin acu s<in>evʉ'ʉrʉ cu maamia vʉnei sua na hʉ'ʉr-in ka'an tavara'ʉ murungisa.
S.PHON: sin aʦu sinevɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ ʦu maamia vɨnei sua na hɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]in kaʔan tava[r|ɾ]aʔɨ mu[r|ɾ]uŋisa
S.FORM: sin acu sinevʉ'ʉrʉ cu maamia vʉnei sua na hʉ'ʉrin ka'an tavara'ʉ murungisa.
S.PHON: sin aʦu sinevɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ ʦu maamia vɨnei sua na hɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]in kaʔan tava[r|ɾ]aʔɨ mu[r|ɾ]uŋisa
S.TRANSL: It was certainly just because the snake was wrapped around it's neck (that's why) it didn't breathe.

S.FORM: aranei cu inia makasua sua vanei mamaarang kanakanavu miena sua kanakanavu:
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anei ʦu inia makasua sua vanei mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ kanakanavu miena sua kanakanavu
S.FORM: aranei cu inia makasua sua vanei mamaarang kanakanavu miena sua kanakanavu:
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anei ʦu inia makasua sua vanei mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ kanakanavu miena sua kanakanavu
S.TRANSL: Since then it was like that, this is the reason why the old Kanakanavu say:

S.FORM: ka'an kita tavara'ʉ t<um>aniurʉ vʉnei iisi 'apitarʉ.
S.PHON: kaʔan kita tava[r|ɾ]aʔɨ tumaniu[r|ɾ]ɨ vɨnei iisi ʔapita[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.FORM: ka'an kita tavara'ʉ tumaniurʉ vʉnei iisi 'apitarʉ.
S.PHON: kaʔan kita tava[r|ɾ]aʔɨ tumaniu[r|ɾ]ɨ vɨnei iisi ʔapita[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.TRANSL: Don't mess with the snake, it is dangerous.

S.FORM: nu t<um>aniurʉ kia vʉnei ia manasʉ tee kita aaka.
S.PHON: nu tumaniu[r|ɾ]ɨ kia vɨnei ia manasɨ tee kita aaka
S.FORM: nu tumaniurʉ kia vʉnei ia manasʉ tee kita aaka.
S.PHON: nu tumaniu[r|ɾ]ɨ kia vɨnei ia manasɨ tee kita aaka
S.TRANSL: If we bully the snake maybe we will be dead.

S.FORM: mastan cu sua ngcou taamu kisʉʉn.
S.PHON: mastan ʦu sua ŋʦou taamu kisɨɨn
S.FORM: mastan cu sua ngcou taamu kisʉʉn.
S.PHON: mastan ʦu sua ŋʦou taamu kisɨɨn
S.TRANSL: Especailly the hundred-pace snake.

S.FORM: nee cʉ'ʉr-ei sua taamu ia una kan kanakanavu ni-muru'ucang taamu misei.
S.PHON: nee ʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]ei sua taamu ia una kan kanakanavu nimu[r|ɾ]uʔuʦaŋ taamu misei
S.FORM: nee cʉ'ʉrei sua taamu ia una kan kanakanavu nimuru'ucang taamu misei.
S.PHON: nee ʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]ei sua taamu ia una kan kanakanavu nimu[r|ɾ]uʔuʦaŋ taamu misei
S.TRANSL: "Look, as for the Tamu snake, there was a Kanakanavu who was married to one!" they say.
But I don't know.

S.FORM: marakan ku tavararʉ isua sua ni-muru'ucang taamu misei.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]akan ku tava[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]ɨ isua sua nimu[r|ɾ]uʔuʦaŋ taamu misei
S.FORM: marakan ku tavararʉ isua sua nimuru'ucang taamu misei.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]akan ku tava[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]ɨ isua sua nimu[r|ɾ]uʔuʦaŋ taamu misei
S.TRANSL: But I don't know about the one married to a Tamu snake they talk about.

S.FORM: sua makai ra'ʉv aku miciko ia manasʉ tavara'ʉ inia.
S.PHON: sua makai [r|ɾ]aʔɨv aku miʦiko ia manasɨ tava[r|ɾ]aʔɨ inia
S.FORM: sua makai ra'ʉv aku miciko ia manasʉ tavara'ʉ inia.
S.PHON: sua makai [r|ɾ]aʔɨv aku miʦiko ia manasɨ tava[r|ɾ]aʔɨ inia
S.TRANSL: As for my wife Miciko, she maybe knows.

S.FORM: sua makasua sua ikita kanakanavu ia vanei kita ka'an t<um>atinra'ʉ vʉnei iisi makasua.
S.PHON: sua makasua sua ikita kanakanavu ia vanei kita kaʔan tumatin[r|ɾ]aʔɨ vɨnei iisi makasua
S.FORM: sua makasua sua ikita kanakanavu ia vanei kita ka'an tumatinra'ʉ vʉnei iisi makasua.
S.PHON: sua makasua sua ikita kanakanavu ia vanei kita kaʔan tumatin[r|ɾ]aʔɨ vɨnei iisi makasua
S.TRANSL: That's why we can't bully snakes.
That's what is told about.
